# Cognitive State

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:CognitiveState`](gmeow-CognitiveState.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/CognitiveState>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/cognition`](../../slices/cognition.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

An agent's intrinsic knowing mode toward a subject — the mental moment grounding the knowledge spectrum and the reified [`gmeow:KnowledgeProficiency`](gmeow-KnowledgeProficiency.md). The agent-side 'knowing' sibling of epistemics' doxastic states and teleology's [`gmeow:IntentionalMode`](gmeow-IntentionalMode.md), all gathered under [`gmeow:MentalMoment`](gmeow-MentalMoment.md) (kernel) so an agent's whole mental life is queryable as one family ([Principle 15](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-15)). Inheres in exactly one agent. NOTE: a [`CognitiveState`](gmeow-CognitiveState.md) (mode) and a [`gmeow:KnowledgeProficiency`](gmeow-KnowledgeProficiency.md) (relator) for the same knowing relation are DIFFERENT individuals — never double-typed ([Principle 12](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-12)).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:MentalMoment`](gmeow-MentalMoment.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:CognitiveState`](gmeow-CognitiveState.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:MentalMoment`](gmeow-MentalMoment.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

# same node as the relator — founded-on is documentation, not a type (Principle 12).
ex:adaPythonKnowing a gmeow:CognitiveState .

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to type an agent's intrinsic knowing mode as a first-class mental moment — the endurant state that grounds the knowledge spectrum and is queried alongside doxastic and conative modes under [`gmeow:MentalMoment`](gmeow-MentalMoment.md) ([Principle 15](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-15)).

### Avoid when

- Avoid double-typing the same knowing relation as both a [`CognitiveState`](gmeow-CognitiveState.md) (mode) and a [`gmeow:KnowledgeProficiency`](gmeow-KnowledgeProficiency.md) (relator) — they are different individuals ([Principle 12](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-12)); avoid it for the flat 80% case (use the [`gmeow:isAwareOf`](../properties/gmeow-isAwareOf.md) … [`gmeow:hasMastered`](../properties/gmeow-hasMastered.md) spectrum) and for a reasoning EPISODE that unfolds in time (that is a [`gmeow:MentalProcess`](gmeow-MentalProcess.md), mentation).

### How to use

- Mint one [`CognitiveState`](gmeow-CognitiveState.md) inhering in the agent; carry the depth as the flat spectrum or promote to a [`gmeow:KnowledgeProficiency`](gmeow-KnowledgeProficiency.md) relator when level/scale/interval/standpoint matter, and let the mentation slice's [`gmeow:producesMentalMoment`](../properties/gmeow-producesMentalMoment.md) (new belief) or [`gmeow:realizesMentalMoment`](../properties/gmeow-realizesMentalMoment.md) (manifest capacity) bridge a knowing-process to the moment it settles.
